title: Elucidating the leaching effect of micro-/nano-plastics on the binding, structural, and oxidative characteristics of bovine serum albumin and its impact on cytotoxicity and oxidative stress in the human lung cancer cell line A549
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2091-2113
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00071H, Paper
Asli Baysal, Hasan Saygin, Ahu Soyocak, Mehmet Kahraman, Emre Apaydin, Pemra Ozbek
The binding mechanism of proteins with micro/nanoplastics are examined by biophysical/chemical indicators, and molecular docking. In addition, cytotoxicity of protein after micro/nanoplastics interaction was tested on A549 cells.
